note: NV has no general state-level auctioneer license (confirmed via NALLOA's no-licensing-board list); NRS chapters found are narrow special cases (Ch.573 public livestock auctions, Ch.482/445B vehicle-consignment auctions), not a general auctioneer license. Auction businesses register locally (e.g. Clark Co./Las Vegas permits) (2026-07-08, hand-verified).
